headline: Emirates Group First-Half Profits Plunge 66% on War and Fuel Costs
summary: Emirates Group reported a 66% drop in first-half profits as regional conflict disruptions and high fuel costs impacted operations, with passenger numbers falling 22%.
why: Aviation profit margins are highly sensitive to jet fuel price volatility and geopolitical airspace closures.

impacts.name: Emirates Group
impacts.why: Sharp drop in profits directly reflects adverse operating conditions.
